name: skill-step-progress
description: Live pane showing the current step and overall progress of this session's flows, one box per run: /commit (and any flow you add in ~/.claude/skill-step-progress/rules.json) by watching the commands it runs, and skills that write their own state to ~/.claude/usage-data/<skill>/<repo>/current.json
